body:
Prove the forge loop instead of assuming content equality makes every sync clean.

- [ ] Run three cycles of agent landing, export, forge squash merge and concurrent human upstream changes followed by validated sync; also cover rebase-merge behavior.
- [ ] Assert zero spurious conflicts and expected content/diffs, first-parent revision numbering and sync second-parent provenance.
- [ ] Include a genuine upstream conflict: record configured owner and keep non-conflicting local work possible on the old upstream base; no force-push or automatic human-main mutation.
- [ ] Use a disposable forge fixture or a faithful local topology model with its limits stated; record any missing real-forge qualification as pending.
- [ ] Commit reproducible throwaway script/report. Redesign ADR before M1 if go criteria fail.
title: S5: Qualify repeated upstream export and sync cycles
